decisive_items: bilateral moderate diffuse bulbar conjunctival hyperemia
Each eye had an inferior symblepharon involving up to three clock hours and cicatrization of the caruncle.
The inferior lacrimal punctum was scarred.
response.rationale: C1 directly captures the bilateral cicatricial conjunctivitis with specific symblepharon and punctal scarring, matching the vignette's explicit diagnosis. R1 states the diagnosis but lacks the bilateral and detailed anatomical spans. Other candidates address only secondary features (blepharitis, dry eye, atopic dermatitis) or lack raw support (R2).

rejected.why: Only meibomian gland dysfunction, not the core cicatricial conjunctivitis findings.
Only dry eye symptoms, missing the cicatricial changes and symblepharon.
Only skin rash, not the ocular cicatricial process.
No raw support spans; relies on nonliteral atopy history, insufficient for diagnosis.
